newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana stock exchange ends week higher.
newsitem.headline: Ghana stock exchange ends week higher.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange index edged up on Friday in moderate trade, closing the week higher on sustained interest in the banking sector and renewed interest in Mobil Oil Ghana Ltd, its market report showed.

The Ghana All-Share index rose 0.26 point to 371.05 points from 369.58 on the previous Friday and 362.88 two weeks before that. A total on 32,570 shares changed hands. Bids outstripped offers by 5,187,650 to 544,070.
The week's main risers included Mobil, which rose 100 cedis to 6,100 cedis on Wednesday. Mobil jumped 400 on April 9 and 300 on April 11.
Other risers were Social Security Bank, up 20 on the week to 1,280 and Ghana Commercial Bank up five on the week to 615.
The main fallers were pharmaceutical and trading company Paterson Zochonis down 20 to 220 and Aluworks, down 20 to 1,180.
